content: Yinni Gusunɔn Hunde u Esekiɛli suɑ mɑ u kɑ nùn dɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun kɔnnɔwɔ ɡe ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ. Kɔnnɔ ɡen miyɑ u tɔmbu yɛndɑ nɔɔbu wɑ. Be sɔɔ, u Yɑɑsɑniɑ Asurin bii tubɑ kɑ Pelɑtiɑ Bɛnɑyɑn bii. Be kpuro bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Isirelibɑn wiruɡibu.
Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ, tɔnun bii, tɔn be ɑ wɑ mi, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ be bɑ kɔ̃sɑ bwisikumɔ mɑ bɑ tɔmbu bwisi kɔ̃si kɛ̃mɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.
Bɑ mɔ̀, n ǹ mɔ tɛ̃ sɑ ko dinu bɑni. Domi Yerusɑlɛmu yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe wekeru. Mɑ bɛsɛ yen tɔmbu sɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɡe yɑɑ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ te sɔɔ.
Yen sɔ̃, tɛ̃ tɔnun bii, ɑ bu ɡerusio.
Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔn Hunde u nùn yɔɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɔ ɑ nɛɛ, nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ yɛ̃ ye be Isirelibɑ bɑ bwisikumɔ kɑ ye bɑ ɡerumɔ.
Wee bɑ beɡibu ɡoomɔ dɑbi dɑbinu wuu ɡe sɔɔ. Mɑ ɡonu yibɑ ben swɛɛ sɔɔ.
Yen sɔ̃, beɡii be bɑ ɡo mi, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe yɑɑ. Mɑ wuu ɡen tii ɡɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɡe wekeru. Adɑmɑ be bɑ tie bɑ wɑsi, bɑ koo bu yɑrɑwɑ bu kɑ doonɑ.
Wee bɑ tɑbun bɛrum mɔ. Adɑmɑ kon de tɑɑ bi, bu bu deemɑ. Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ ye ɡeruɑ.
Kon de bu yɑri wuu ɡen di. Kpɑ n bu tɔn tukobu nɔmu bɛriɑ. Nɡe mɛyɑ kon kɑ bu sirisinɑ.
Tɑbu sɔɔrɑ bɑ koo ɡbi. Kon bu siri be Isirelibɑ, ben tem nɔɔ burɑ yerɔ. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ bɑ koo ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ.
Wuu ɡe, ɡɑ ǹ bu nɛnumɔ nɡe wekeru. Bɑ ǹ ko n mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɡe yɑɑ te sɔɔ. Ben tem nɔɔ burɑ yerɔwɑ kon bu siri.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, bɑ koo ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ wìn ɡere bɑ ǹ mɛm nɔɔwɛ, kɑ wìn woodɑbɑ bɑ ǹ swĩi. Mɑ bɑ sere bwese tuku ni nu kɑ bu sikerenɛn ɡɑri swĩi.

Sɑnɑm mɛ Esekiɛli u Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɑri yi ɡerumɔ, yerɑ Pelɑtiɑ Bɛnɑyɑn bii u kpunɑ u ɡu. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ Esekiɛli u wuswɑɑ tem ɡirɑri u nɔɔɡiru suɑ u nɛɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ, kɑɑ dewɑ Isireli be bɑ tie bu ɡbisuku?
Yinni Gusunɔ u koo win tɔn
be bɑ yɑrinɛ mɛnnɑ
Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ,

tɔnun bii, wee, be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ bɑ Isirelibɑ, wunɛn mɛro bisibu, kɑ be bɑ tie bwisi kɛ̃mɔ bɑ mɔ̀, bu yɔ̃ro mi bɑ yoru dimɔ mi, bɑ n kɑ Yinni Gusunɔ tonde, domi be, be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ mi, beyɑ bɑ tem mɛ wɛ̃.
Adɑmɑ ɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɔ ɑ nɛɛ, bɑɑ mɛ nɑ derɑ bɑ yɑrinɛ mi, bɑ wɑ̃ɑ tem tukumɔ, sɔ̃ɔ teeru ko nɑ n kɑ bu wɑ̃ɑ nɡe mɛ nɑ rɑ n wɑ̃ɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ.
Kpɑ n bu mɛnnɑ n yɑrɑ bwese nin suunu sɔɔn di mi bɑ yɑrinɛ mi, n bu Isirelibɑn tem wɛ̃.
Mɛyɑ bɑ koo nɑ kpɑ bu bũu ni kpuro wunɑ ni bɑ rɑ rɑɑ sɑ̃ mi, ni nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ǹ kĩ.
Kon bu ɡɔ̃ru teu wɛ̃ kpɑ n bu bwisiku kpɑɑnu wɛ̃. Kon ben ɡɔ̃ru ɡe ɡɑ rɑɑ bɔɔbu nɡe kperu mi wunɑ, kpɑ n bu ɡɔ̃ru kpɔɔ wɛ̃ ɡe ɡɑ du.
Kpɑ bu kɑ nɛn ɡere mɛm nɔɔwɑ, bu nɛn woodɑbɑ swĩi. Bɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɛn tɔmbu, kpɑ nɑ n mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ Gusunɔ ben Yinni.
Adɑmɑ be bɑ yɔ̃rɑri bɑ ben kĩru swĩi bɑ dɑ bɑ bũnu sɑ̃ɑmɔ ni nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ǹ kĩ mi, kon bu ben kookoosun ɑre kɔsiɑ. Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔn yiikon ɡirimɑ
yɑ yɑrɑ Yerusɑlɛmun di
Yen biruwɑ wɔllun kɔ̃so be, bɑ kɑsi dɛriɑ bɑ seewɑ kɑ ben uruu be sɑnnu. Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔn yiikon ɡirimɑ yɑ sɔ̃ɔsire ben wɔllɔ.
Mɑ win yiikon ɡirimɑ ye, yɑ seewɑ wuu suunun di yɑ dɑ yɑ wɑ̃ɑ ɡuuru ɡɑrun wɔllɔ, wuun sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ.
Mɑ Gusunɔn Hunde u Esekiɛli suɑ kɑ̃si te sɔɔ, u kɑ wurɑmɑ Bɑbiloniɔ mi Isirelibɑ bɑ yoru dimɔ. Sɑɑ yerɑ kɑ̃si te u wɑɑmɔ mi, tɑ kpɑ.
Mɑ u Isireli be bɑ yoru dimɔ mi, sɔ̃ɔwɑ kpuro ye Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ u wɑ.
